title: Inverse image of an inverse tower with compatible local bases
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small in a universe larger than their objects and morphisms [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with finite limits. Let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ preserve finite limits and coverings, and write $f^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ for its geometric inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-site-inverse-image-tensor]. Let $(R_n,\rho_n)_{n\ge1}$ be an inverse tower of sheaves of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. For each $n$ let $M_n$ be an $R_n$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with additive transition $t_n:M_{n+1}\to M_n$ satisfying $t_n(a m)=\rho_n(a)t_n(m)$. Put $R=\varprojlim_n R_n$ and $M=\varprojlim_n M_n$, with sectionwise ring and module operations [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Suppose the canonical projection-induced ring map
$$\kappa:f^{-1}R\longrightarrow\varprojlim_n f^{-1}R_n$$
is an isomorphism. Suppose there is a covering $\{V_i\to1_{\mathcal C}\}$ and, for every $i,n$, an $R_n|_{V_i}$-linear isomorphism $b_{i,n}:R_n|_{V_i}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n|_{V_i}$, such that $t_n b_{i,n+1}=b_{i,n}\rho_n$ after restriction [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Then the canonical projection-induced comparison
$$\theta:f^{-1}M\longrightarrow\varprojlim_n f^{-1}M_n$$
is an isomorphism, linear over $\kappa$ when the right hand side has its coordinatewise $\varprojlim_n f^{-1}R_n$-action. The maps $b_{i,n}$ induce $R|_{V_i}\cong M|_{V_i}$, and on $\mathcal D/u(V_i)$ these identifications identify $\theta$ with the restriction of $\kappa$. The comparison is natural for homomorphisms of ring towers and compatible semilinear morphisms of module towers; it does not depend on the chosen covering or bases.
